meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆成有依据的小步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果习惯把大目标拆成小步骤、按节奏逐项完成。
copy.tagline_en: Break large goals into evidence-based steps and loop through them.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to break big goals into smaller, evidence-driven steps and keep iterating.

howto.what: 它会进入“超工作”目标循环:先读取参考文件并按流程注册目标,把任务拆成超细步骤、每步标记状态,且每个成功标准都要有来自终端、网页等真实界面的可观察证据;代码编辑、测试与 QA 会委派给 Codex 子代理,并遵循手动 QA 与停止规则。
howto.when: 当你提到“ulw-loop”“ulw”等触发词,或提出证据驱动、需要手动验收的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个任务拆成小步,每步都记录证据。
say.note: Claude 会先注册目标,再按流程逐步执行并采证。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式做证据驱动的执行,并安排手动 QA。
say.note: 会让代码和 QA 交给子代理,按停止规则判断完成。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 ulw-loop 会话来处理这堆无关的新需求。
say.note: 会为新目标使用新的 session 标识,不复用已完成状态。

howto.what_en: Registers goals, decomposes work into tiny steps, requires observable evidence from real surfaces (terminal, HTTP, browser), delegates code/QA to Codex agents, and follows manual QA and stop rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'ulw-loop'/'ulw' or asks for evidence-driven, long-running delivery with manual QA.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break down this task and log evidence at each step.
say_en.note: Claude registers a goal, then executes step-by-step while collecting evidence.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode for evidence-led execution and include manual QA.
say_en.note: Code and QA are delegated; stop rules decide when it's done.

say_en.text: Start a fresh ulw-loop session for this new unrelated work.
say_en.note: A new session id is used so completed state isn't reused.
